title: Ministry of Social and Family Development
what_it_is: Ministry of Social and Family Development

sections.label: COVID-19 financial and social support
sections.summary: ComCare, the Temporary Relief Fund, the COVID-19 Support Grant and The Courage Fund provided financial and social support to lower income and vulnerable Singaporeans affected by COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Through ComCare, the Temporary Relief Fund, the COVID-19 Support Grant, and The Courage Fund, we provided financial and social support to lower income and vulnerable Singaporeans affected by COVID-19 during the Circuit Breaker and the phased opening up of our economy.

sections.label: Support for persons with disabilities
sections.summary: MSF is working with SG Enable and other partners to implement the Enabling Masterplan 3 and develop plans for the next phase beyond 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MSF is committed to building an inclusive society by strengthening support for persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We are working with SG Enable and other partners to implement the Enabling Masterplan 3 and develop plans for the next phase beyond 2021.

sections.label: Preschool subsidies and KidSTART expansion
sections.summary: Preschool subsidies were enhanced, more preschools will be built, and KidSTART will expand to more regions for children from low-income families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We have significantly enhanced preschool subsidies so that more families pay less for preschool.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will continue to work with Anchor Operators to build more preschools, and appoint more Partner Operators to assure families that 80% of preschoolers can have a place in Government-supported preschools by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will also continue to enhance training and career progression of early childhood educators, and raise preschool quality via the Singapore Preschool Accreditation Framework (SPARK).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will strengthen holistic and upstream support for more children from low-income families with the expansion of KidSTART to more regions.

sections.label: COVID-19 mental health support
sections.summary: The National CARE Hotline was set up to provide psychological and emotional support, and the Youth Mental Well-Being Network will strengthen support for youths and families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: To support families and Singaporeans who faced emotional and psychological stresses during the COVID-19 Circuit Breaker, we set up the National CARE Hotline to provide psychological and emotional support, and referrals for intervention.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Youth Mental Well-Being Network will develop and implement initiatives to strengthen support for youths and their families.

sections.label: Supporting SSAs through funds
sections.summary: With NCSS, SSAs will be supported through the Invictus Fund, Community Capability Trust and other programmes to build capability and capacity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: With the National Council of Social Service (NCSS), we will support SSAs through the Invictus Fund, Community Capability Trust, and other supporting programmes and initiatives to build capability and capacity for both the immediate term and the longer term.

sections.label: SSA sector digitalisation roadmap
sections.summary: NCSS is developing a Sector Digitalisation Roadmap to help SSAs use innovation, digitalisation and data to deliver social services more effectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NCSS is developing a Sector Digitalisation Roadmap to help build SSAs’ capabilities in leveraging innovation, digitalisation, and better use of data, to deliver social services more effectively.
